name: Vandreruten Aarhus-Silkeborg
description_md:
Vandreruten Aarhus-Silkeborg is a hard waymarked hiking route in DK spanning 79.5 km. The trail features 1175 m of ascent and 1149 m of descent, requiring about 23 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

Walkers pass within 200 m of Aqua, within 700 m of Diocese of Århus, and within 900 m of Aarhus.
